verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset checks explicitly cover checking whether an asset's data needs refreshing, and check results appear per asset in the UI with severity levels. Dagster+ alerts can notify on critical deployment events. However, the evidence never documents freshness policies, a per-table last-updated view, or an alert that fires specifically when an asset misses its expected cadence, and alerts are tied to the paid Dagster+ tier. Missing for 10: explicit freshness-policy or SLA documentation, documented alerting on freshness or missed-cadence failures, a per-table freshness status view, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence

citations.quote: Check if an asset's data needs refreshing
Asset check results will appear in the UI and can be customized through the use of metadata and severity levels
Dagster+ alerts can notify you of critical events occurring in your deployment so you can catch potential issues early
